title: Chapter 315 - 315 Not Strange; Nice To Meet You, President!
content:
Chapter 315 - 315 Not Strange; Nice To Meet You, President!

Chapter 315 - 315 Not Strange; Nice to Meet You, President!

315 Not Strange; Nice to Meet You, President!

Amidst Zhu Yuanhui’s maniacal laughter, Lin Fan’s phone rang again.

This time, it was from President Ma of Little Tanuki Group.

President Da Ma’s thoughts were similar to President Xiao Ma. He also wanted to communicate with his future boss as much as possible.

Lin Fan had already received calls from Zhang Daming and President Xiao Ma. It was not strange for him to receive a call from President Da Ma.

Hence, he pressed the answer button.

“Hello, Mr. Lin!” President Ma said happily.

Lin Fan did not bother to say anything more and just asked, “President Ma, is there a partnership between Little Tanuki Group and Magpie Coffee?”

President Ma instinctively felt that Lin Fan’s tone was a little off.

He thought for a moment and said,” Magpie Coffee is the largest coffee dealer in the world. In order to open up the Hua Nation market, the chairman of Magpie Coffee personally came to our Little Tanuki Group and spent a lot of money to set up a flagship store and carry out a series of activities and promotions…”

His explanation was very simple. Magpie Coffee and Ah Li Group did have a partnership.

However, it was only a simple business cooperation.

Clearly, he was giving himself some leeway.

This was definitely a smart move.

Lin Fan understood the meaning behind his words and did not mind it. He said calmly, “I planted some coffee. Zhu Yuanhui, the regional manager of the Southern Hua Nation of Magpie Coffee, just told me that if I don’t let him buy it, he’ll make sure that my coffee beans will never leave the mountain.”

President Ma’s eyebrows twitched slightly as he thought, ‘Fortunately, I was smart and didn’t point out the deep cooperation between Magpie Coffee and Little Tanuki Group.’

Otherwise, would Lin Fan not vent his anger on him?

“How exactly is Magpie Coffee managing their employees? It’s simply chaos! Zhu Yuanhui, the regional manager for the Southern Hua Nation?

“Mr. Lin, please wait a moment. I’ll get Magpie Coffee to give you an explanation!”

“Alright,” said Lin Fan.

After hanging up the phone…

Zhu Yuanhui held back his laughter and said, “Was that a call from President Ma, the chairman of Little Tanuki Group? And you’re also a shareholder of Little Tanuki Group?”

“Yes,” Lin Fan said.

After Zhu Yuanhui heard Lin Fan’s answer, he laughed until tears flowed out.

“What should I do now? I’m so scared. Really, I’m so scared…Hahaha!”

Zhu Yuanhui could not help but laugh. “Bro, since you’re already a shareholder of so many giant companies, you wouldn’t mind becoming a shareholder of Magpie Coffee too, right? Let’s have the president of Magpie Coffee give me a call. I’ve never spoken to the president before. Let me experience it… Hahaha!”

At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang again.

This time, it was an unknown number from overseas.

Lin Fan casually pressed the answer button.

“Hello, Mr. Lin…”

There was a burst of words in broken Hua Nation language being said over the phone.

“Hello, Mr. Lin.” A magnetic voice was heard. “The person who just spoke was Mr. George Davis, the president of Magpie Coffee. I’m his secretary and interpreter, Luo Fang.”

Lin Fan glanced at Zhu Yuanhui and said, “This call came at the right time. Zhu Yuanhui, the manager of the Southern Hua Nation region, happens to be forcefully purchasing the coffee beans I planted myself.”

Then, Lin Fan pressed the speaker button and said, “Didn’t you want to experience talking to your president?”

“Really?” Zhu Yuanhui laughed again. “Did he already call? Hahaha! Good!”

At this moment, Luo Fang had already translated Lin Fan’s words to George Davis.

How smart was George Davis to be able to make Magpie Coffee the number one coffee company in the world?

After thinking about it for a while, he knew the general situation.

At this moment, Zhu Yuanhui shouted into the phone, “Are you the president of our Magpie Coffee?”

“I’m the president’s secretary and interpreter,” Luo Fang said.

“Hahaha! There’s also a secretary and an interpreter. Amazing, amazing! Hahaha!” Zhu Yuanhui roared with laughter.

“In this case… Tell that bullsh*t president that Lin Fan’s coffee beans will either be bought for one million or they’ll never leave the mountain!

“It’s useless even if Jesus comes!”

After saying that, Zhu Yuanhui overstepped his authority and directly pressed the button to end the call.

Then, he laughed even harder and almost fell to the ground.

If the first phone call was really from the president of Alphabet, Zhang Daming, Zhu Yuanhui would still believe it a little.

However, the second call was from President Xiao Ma of Penguin Group, the third call was from President Da Ma of Little Tanuki Group, and the fourth call was from the secretary and interpreter of the president of Magpie Coffee… His little bit of faith was completely shattered.

One had to know…

Alphabet, Penguin, and Little Tanuki were the three giants of Hua Nation’s internet industry.

It would still be believable if someone knew people from those companies.

However, if someone said that they were a shareholder of the three companies, that would definitely be a joke.

In the end, Lin Fan even said that the secretary and interpreter of the president of Magpie Coffee called.

The president of Magpie Coffee did not need an interpreter. He was from Hua Nation!

All of this meant that Lin Fan had been bragging from the start! How awesome!

However…

Zhu Yuanhui did not know that the president he was thinking of was only the president of the Hua Nation region of Magpie Coffee. Naturally, this person did not have an interpreter.

Lin Fan received a call from the president of the main company of Magpie Coffee. It was normal for him to have an interpreter.

Just as Zhu Yuanhui was about to fall to the ground laughing, the phone in his pocket rang.

Zhu Yuanhui slowly took out his phone. When he saw the caller ID, his expression turned solemn.

It was because the caller was actually the president of the Hua Nation region, Wang Heping!

Zhu Yuanhui had once seen the contact information of the higher-ups of Magpie Coffee on the internal network.

Without any hesitation, he added all of them to his contact list in case it would be useful in the future.

Now, it really came in handy!

Moreover, it was the high and mighty president who called personally!

What kind of honor was this?

Could it be that the president was going to promote him?

Thinking of this, Zhu Yuanhui’s heart was filled with excitement.

He quickly straightened his clothes, cleared his throat, walked to the side, and said in a tone that was full of worship, “Hello, President. I’m Zhu Yuanhui, the regional manager of the Southern Hua Nation for Magpie Coffee.”

First, he took the initiative to greet him, and then, he introduced himself.

Zhu Yuanhui was already imagining the president’s compliments.

However…

A deafening roar immediately sounded from the other end of the phone.

“Zhu Yuanhui, f*ck you!”
